reason: The backend's slogdet (_nplinalg.slogdet) now refuses a non-square matrix with LinAlgError, as det, inv and solve already do: before, a 3 x 4 matrix gave a log-determinant and 256 x 257 gave (0, -inf). np.linalg.slogdet checked first, so only direct callers saw it (the grader's r684d probe on #684). The worker grows by the one check (+70); the CLI bundle carries the same code (pyjs +167).
